Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording of the conference call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
This is with reference to our earlier letter dated August 5, 2026, intimating about the 
Company’s conference call for analyst/ investors to be held on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, 
at 16.00 hours IST, to discuss the Company’s financial performance on its Un-audited 
Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and the way forward.  
 
In this context and pursuant to the requirement of Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Para A 
of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 
2015 the link of the Audio recording of the said conference call conducted for the analysts/ 
investors today can be downloaded by clicking on the following link: 
 
https://www.jyothylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Jyothy-Recording-%E2%80%93-
Analyst-Investor-Call-August-12-2026.mp4   
 
Kindly take the above on your record and disseminate the same for the information of 
investors. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Jyothy Labs Limited
